correctness.rationale: The 3-cut tangram property is equivalent to containing an image of one of the four minimal doubled-variable patterns S3={AA,ABACBC,ABCACB,ABCBAC}; cf. Ochem–Pierron 2025 §2. Independently expanded all nonerasing ternary substitutions of these patterns through length8, searched all 3^n labeled words for n<=8, and recovered counts 3,6,12,18,30,24,18,0. The 18 length7 survivors split into three symbol-permutation/reversal orbits of six with representatives 0102010,0102101,0121012. The original verifier also uses direct cut and independent incremental suffix enumeration; no accepted length8 word implies no longer accepted word, since any longer contains an initial length8 factor. All conclusions finite and exhaustive.
